title: papaver argemone f. glabrum
intro: Papaver argemone f. glabrum, commonly known as Argemone glabra, is a plant species within the poppy family (Papaveraceae) that is native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to treat various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Papaver argemone f. glabrum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infection, and lower body temperature. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
